_note: Mock fixture. Values summarized from the public Hilti system drawing W-L-2244 (Jan 21, 2020). The project condition (steel pipe) comes from the case.

pages.text: System No. W-L-2244. Gypsum wall. Penetrants: PVC pipe Schedule 40 up to 2 in, CPVC pipe SDR 13.5 up to 2 in. F Ratings 1 and 2 hr. T Ratings 0, 1 and 2 hr. FS-ONE MAX sealant.

extract.https://hilti.com/media-canonical/ASSET_: System No. W-L-2244, January 21, 2020. Nonmetallic pipes: PVC and CPVC up to 2 in.

report.summary: The submitted firestop system is only listed for plastic pipe, but the drawings show steel pipe at this wall.
report.note_to_subcontractor: Please resubmit with a listed firestop system that covers steel pipe through a gypsum wall.

finding_titles.validity-cond-penetrant: Fire listing doesn't cover steel pipe

why_it_matters.validity-cond-penetrant: A firestop system is only proven for what it was tested with. Used on steel pipe, this one has no fire rating at all.
